title: Interactive Mycelium Map
definition: A dynamic graphical representation of concepts, their relationships, and their domains in the CADMIES knowledge system.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a digital map that shows how different ideas are connected and grouped. You can zoom in, click on nodes for more info, and interact with the legend.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The interactive mycelium map is a graph-based visualization tool that represents concepts as nodes and their relationships as edges. It categorizes concepts into domains, allowing for easy navigation and exploration.
difficulty_levels.expert: The interactive mycelium map serves as a network model of knowledge within the CADMIES system. It leverages graph theory to visualize complex relationships between concepts and their domains. The map provides insights into the structure and interconnectedness of the CADMIES knowledge system, highlighting philosophical implications and potential edge cases.

extra_fields.insight: The interactive mycelium map allows for a dynamic exploration of the CADMIES knowledge system, revealing its underlying structure and connections.
